activation: blocked pending House landing of dk2479
disabled_rule_lines_after_landing: rule name="Record pending delegated handoffs" on="house.hand" by="anyone" off="yes" do="handoff.open $target to_field=who owner=$by"
rule name="Recognize pending recipient refusals" on="say" by="anyone" off="yes" do="handoff.observe $said policy=dk2486"

rule name="Wake delegator when a pending handoff is refused" on="make" by="anyone" off="yes" do="handoff.notify $target text=\"Handoff blocked: {task}; recipient {recipient}. {reason} — {source}\" cc=\"Alex\"" kind="handoff-refusal"
rule name="Accept handoff when recipient instructs worker" on="house.tell" by="anyone" off="yes" do="handoff.close $target recipient=$by"
